notes.title: Partial Controller Support
notes.content:
Partial Controller Support (Xbox, PS5, Nintendo Etc.) For NDR


[b][Button Description][/b]

Button 0: Tail Shooting (SPACE)
Button 1: Portal Skill (W)
Button 2: Pause (ESC)
Button 3: Time Machine Skill (Q)
Button 4(L1): Left Swing (Left Arrow)
Button 5(R1): Right Swing (Right Arrow)
Touch Pad: Select Menu (Mouse Cursor)
